description: kotoba-datomic §4 membrane verdict — a content-addressed witness that an L3 deterministic cell evaluated a record under the (L1 schema, L2 Rego, L3 cell) triple defined for its collection. Emitted by Pregel cells (e.g. FeedPostCell for app.bsky.feed.post) into the cell's own MST as a sidecar. Per ADR-2605231400 SPEC §4 + ADR-2605192200 §2 + ADR-2605192400. Approve/reject/escalate verdicts let downstream consumers (kotoba-datomic-projection, mst-projector, ipfs-pinner) decide whether to propagate the original record into the projection cache, anchor it, or quarantine it pending Council review.

subject.description: AT URI + CID of the record being adjudicated.

verdict.description: Deterministic verdict. `escalate` means the cell could not decide alone and routes to CouncilDeliberationCell (Lv6+ ≥3) per ADR-2605192300.

evidence.description: Per-finding evidence. Sorted by (category, evidence) for determinism — same input MUST produce byte-identical evidence array.

verdictCid.description: Content-addressed verdict hash. `sha256-<hex>` of canonical JSON of (record_cid, kind, reason, sorted_evidence). Re-running the cell on the same input MUST yield the same verdictCid.

regoModule.description: OPA package name of the L2 policy module consulted, e.g. `app.bsky.feed.post`. Optional; emitted when the verdict consumed an external Rego decision rather than the in-cell mirror.

cellId.description: Pregel cell name that produced the verdict, e.g. `FeedPostCell`. Matches a key in `50-infra/murakumo/fleet.toml [cells.*]`.

createdAt.description: Verdict timestamp. Sourced from the dispatcher's ctx.now, never the cell's local clock — required for determinism (cell can be re-run from MST history).

category.description: One of: `2a`..`2h` (Charter Rider category codes), `advertising`, `eschatology`, `gore`, `gore-educational`, `ja-prohibited`, `schema`, `length`, `missing-required`, `external` (delegated OPA decision).

evidence.description: Short evidence string. For Charter Rider hits: the matched lexical term. For schema: the field/constraint name. Truncated to 512 chars.
